newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume rises.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices ended mixed on Friday as volume rose to 898 kilos from 651 on Thursday.
Dealers said demand was buoyed by easier prices in Europe.

"There was firm demand...in the second session because of expectations of a higher dollar in domestic currency markets on Monday. Buyers aimed to hedge themselves against the dollar through gold," said a free market dealer.
"Easier world ounce prices and support expected at $378 also created a good opportunity to buy," he added.
Gold dropped to $378.55 an ounce in line with world trends from Thursday's $379.00 close.
But it rose to 1,193,800 lira per gram from 1,190,000 as the lira ended at 97,620 to the dollar against yesterday's 97,440.
Volume leapt to 510 kilos in the second session from 388 in the morning. Some 72 percent of total turnover was in lira terms.
